title: Battle of Albemarle Sound
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Albemarle Sound", at revision 1370106099, opens: "The Battle of Albemarle Sound was an inconclusive naval battle fought in May 1864 along the coast of North Carolina during the American Civil War. Three Confederate warships, including an ironclad, engaged eight Union gunboats. The action ended indecisively due to the sunset." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2890896, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1864 battle of the American Civil War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
